📊 Export Professional Excel Report
✅ Step 1 — Export your data as JSON
Click the button below to download your data file.
🐍 Step 2 — Run the Python script on your PC
Place pladis_excel_builder.py in the same folder as your JSON file, then run:
python3 pladis_excel_builder.py Pladis_QMS_Backup_2026-06-29.json
💡 Python 3 must be installed. Install openpyxl once: pip install openpyxl
📁 Step 3 — Open the generated Excel file
The script creates Pladis_QMS_Report_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx with:
✅ Full colors & formatting  |  ✅ 9 professional sheets  |  ✅ YES=green / NO=red  |  ✅ PASS/FAIL colors
Script file: pladis_excel_builder.py
